thread:
maria: RFC follow-up: propose extracting the inference policy evaluation into a small, dedicated policy-plane to shrink the runtime contract. Goal: fewer branching hotpaths + simpler runtime tests.
aj: Sounds good. What's the minimal viable cutover path?
maria: Minimal path: 1) deploy read-only policy-plane API, 2) snapshot backfill + CDC deltas, 3) sidecar shim for legacy adapters, 4) route a shard subset to policy-plane, 5) ramp and retire shims.
simon: For snapshot, use a read replica to avoid locks. How fast do we need CDC?
maria: CDC should be near-real-time (<1s lag target) but initial backfill will be bulk. SQL for snapshot: 
```sql
INSERT INTO policy_plane.policies (id, cfg, updated_at)
SELECT id, cfg, updated_at FROM replica.inference_policies WHERE updated_at <= :T0;
```
Then run a Kafka consumer to apply deltas.
katie: How to limit tenant blast radius?
simon: Router will add header `x-policy-plane=enabled` for selected shard ids; Envoy filter routes those to policy-plane. Start with 5% shard coverage.
aj: Writes? must pick a single source of truth.
maria: New policy service becomes authoritative. During cutover, writes are routed through the policy service which writes new store and emits CDC events. We'll reject direct legacy writes after Tcut to avoid split-brain.
katie: Monitoring / SLO gates?
maria: Dashboards + alerts: `policy_plane_5xx > 0.2%` sustained 5m, `p95_latency_delta > 30ms` sustained 10m, `adapter.sidecar_fallback_rate > 1%` sustained 10m. Synthetic probe per canary tenant every 30s.
infra-bot: Deploy note: add envoy filter `policy-plane-route`, canary the router image, schedule DB snapshot on low-traffic window; use `kubectl rollout status` during canary.
simon: Rollback plan? revert envoy config, route back to legacy, disable sidecars. Also implement a circuit to failover to legacy on policy-plane TTL misses or errors.
aj: Tests before canary: unit + contract lints, integration test hitting sidecar, load test at expected lookup QPS, chaos test killing sidecar.
maria: We'll include a compatibility shim mapping policy_v1->policy_v2 for a 6-week window. Add debt ticket INF-8200: "policy-plane debt-sink: audit and prune legacy adapters."
katie: Cost implications? CDC + sidecars add infra. Estimate +2-3% infra until cutover. Add to ops forecast.
simon: Owners/timeline?
maria: Owners: maria (arch lead), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (ops). Timeline: spike this sprint, infra canary next week, ramp over 3 weeks, full cut by end of next month.
katie: I'll prepare the runbook and dashboards. Sync tomorrow 9am for dry-run.
maria: I'll update RFC with scripts, SQL, alert rules, and the rollout checklist. Thanks all. :rocket:
